QUOTE: llama.cpp is a git submodule that CMake builds in-tree... `.gitmodules` points `extern/llama.cpp` at `ggml-org/llama.cpp`, pinned to `20a04b22`. ... Not fetched like the others: ... via `FetchContent`... llama.cpp is `add_subdirectory(llama.cpp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)`.

WHY: The answer states llama.cpp is a git submodule at extern/llama.cpp, contrasted with FetchContent deps, so it is not fetched by the build.
